verdict.rationale: Glama's /mcp/reference page describes programmatic access: searching the curated server catalog, inspecting capabilities and keeping your own directory synchronized. A community user also mentions making "API attempts", which suggests some public API exists, but its scope and documentation depth are unclear and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), documented endpoints and authentication, API coverage of hosting, gateway and chat actions, and hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Search Glama's curated catalog of open-source servers and remote connectors, inspect their capabilities, and keep your own directory synchronized.
